# Executive summary

This CPU-only clean-room audit finds three scoped mechanism verifications (Claims 1–3), one literal comparator-attribution falsification (Claim 4), and two inconclusive empirical claims (Claims 5–6). The source archive is hash-pinned and no author executable repository was identified. The finite audits support only their stated mechanisms; missing paper-era artifacts were not replaced with proxies. All work ran locally without billed compute.

## Scope & cost

|  | This reproduction | Full replication |
|---|---|---|
| Scope | Finite CPU mechanism audits; primary-source comparator/provenance checks | Full source-data experiments, adaptive policies, 3,000-trial studies, and asymptotic conditions |
| Hardware | Local CPU | Undisclosed by paper; likely CPU/LLM/API and data infrastructure required |
| Compute time | Short deterministic CPU tests; 22 tests total | Not reproducible from released artifacts |
| Cost | $0 billed; no Jobs/GPU/Bucket | Unknown; paper-era LLM labels and unreleased data/protocol required |
| Outcome | C1–3 scoped verified; C4 literal-source falsified; C5–6 inconclusive | Not established |

**Links:** [public implementation](https://github.com/MachineLearning-Nerd/icml26-repro-BwufLjXbMO-learning-u-statistics-active-inference) · [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.11638) · `evidence/SHA256SUMS`.
